note: Tiers are assigned by the registry with the rule in SPEC.md section 3.2 and frozen from release. `current` marks models on sale as of the snapshot date. Native identifiers come from https://models.dev via canonical_model_id; on bedrock the bare model id is listed when present, and bedrock-runtime needs a geographic or global inference profile (us., eu., global.) in front of it. Entries follow SPEC.md v0.2.0 and need verifiable evidence.

specials.rt: Real-time streaming or duplex interaction (such as live voice on omni or streaming speech-to-text on transcribe).
specials.guard: Safety, content moderation or prompt-injection guardrails.
specials.ocr: Document optical character recognition and layout extraction.
specials.research: Autonomous multi-step deep research and report synthesis.
specials.gui: Graphical user interface grounding and control (desktop computer use, browser automation and mobile device agents).
specials.robotics: Embodied robotics reasoning and physical-world control.
specials.finance: Financial analysis, markets and accounting specialisation.
specials.legal: Legal reasoning, statutory analysis and compliance specialisation.
specials.voiceclone: Voice cloning from a reference speaker sample (on tts).
specials.voicedesign: Generating a synthetic voice from a text description (on tts).
